meta.label: MEMBERS: Aisha Rahman (userId aisha): learns docker, pytorch, sql; teaches python; interests computer vision, healthcare AI, open source; current roadmap focus:

value.title: AI-Powered Healthcare Image Analysis Web App
value.pitch: Build a web application that uses computer vision to analyze healthcare images, integrating Docker, PyTorch, SQL, React, and AWS, with each member practicing their target skills and reviewing peers' work.

issues.title: Set up Docker environment for project
issues.body:
Create a Dockerfile and docker-compose setup to containerize the backend services.

Acceptance Criteria:
- [ ] Dockerfile builds successfully
- [ ] docker-compose.yml orchestrates services correctly
- [ ] Documentation on how to build and run containers included

issues.title: Design and implement SQL database schema
issues.body:
Create SQL schema to store healthcare image metadata and analysis results.

Acceptance Criteria:
- [ ] Schema supports efficient queries for images and results
- [ ] SQL scripts for schema creation provided
- [ ] Schema reviewed and optimized by reviewer

issues.title: Develop PyTorch model for image classification
issues.body:
Implement a PyTorch model to classify healthcare images.

Acceptance Criteria:
- [ ] Model architecture defined and documented
- [ ] Training script runs and achieves baseline accuracy
- [ ] Code reviewed and feedback addressed

issues.title: Create Python API for model inference
issues.body:
Develop a Python REST API to serve the PyTorch model predictions.

Acceptance Criteria:
- [ ] API endpoints for image upload and result retrieval
- [ ] Unit tests cover main functionalities
- [ ] Code reviewed and approved by reviewer

issues.title: Build React frontend for user interaction
issues.body:
Develop a React interface to upload images and display analysis results.

Acceptance Criteria:
- [ ] Image upload component implemented
- [ ] Results displayed clearly and accessibly
- [ ] Code reviewed by reviewer

issues.title: Integrate AWS for image storage and hosting
issues.body:
Set up AWS services to store images and host the application.

Acceptance Criteria:
- [ ] Images stored securely on AWS S3
- [ ] Application hosted or deployed using AWS services
- [ ] Deployment scripts or instructions documented
- [ ] Reviewed by AWS expert

issues.title: Implement SQL queries for data retrieval
issues.body:
Write optimized SQL queries to retrieve image data and analysis results for the frontend.

Acceptance Criteria:
- [ ] Queries tested and performant
- [ ] Queries integrated into backend API
- [ ] Reviewed and approved by SQL expert

issues.title: Dockerize frontend and backend for deployment
issues.body:
Containerize the React frontend and Python backend for seamless deployment.

Acceptance Criteria:
- [ ] Dockerfiles for frontend and backend created
- [ ] Containers build and run without errors
- [ ] Documentation updated for deployment
- [ ] Reviewed by Docker expert
